release-deployment-safety.why: this is the v1.2.0 release cut: a backward-compatible minor with a changelog record
release-deployment-safety.what: bumped package.json + package-lock.json + VERSION from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0 (the manifest already led at 1.2.0) and dated the CHANGELOG 1.2.0 entry; the release is additive (new travelling gates), so existing consumers need no action
quotes: Every change must be independently deployable, backward-compatible, observable while it rolls out

skeptical-audit.why: the release metadata is accurate and consistent, not asserted loosely
skeptical-audit.what: verified package.json, package-lock.json, VERSION and the manifest all read 1.2.0, the CHANGELOG entry is dated (no longer Unreleased), and the full suite + arch + upstream-integrity are green before cutting
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: reviewed the release bump in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch on the version bump (no code/schema change); confirmed completeness and consistency; recorded in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion

architectural-decision-records.why: no new architectural decision; this cuts the release of work already recorded in ADRs 0047 and 0056-0067

verifiable-quality-gates.why: no automated check added or changed; a version bump verified by the existing gates

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: no behavior change; version metadata only

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system/data architecture or code change

sre-operational-readiness.why: no runtime service, SLI/SLO, or alerting surface

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration
